column1: W1e. Instrument stack and calibration log
# One row per calibration. A NanoVNA has no factory calibration to fall back on, so every change of pad, filter, jumper or span is a different instrument until it is calibrated again.
# The 50 ohm check is the gate: put a good load on the reference plane and sweep. Whatever departure from a flat 1.0 you see is the floor on your measurement uncertainty until you recalibrate.
